description: This PHP class file defines the class OA_Maintenance_Priority_AdServer_Task_ECPMforRemnant, which extends a common eCPM calculation class. It implements algorithms for calculating remnant campaign probabilities, impressions, and eCPMs for low-priority ad campaigns within an ad server system, including methods for data preloading, impression calculations, and probability estimations.

classes.name: OA_Maintenance_Priority_AdServer_Task_ECPMforRemnant
classes.description: A class to carry out the task of calculating eCPM remnant probabilities for low-priority ad campaigns, extending the common eCPM class, with methods for algorithm execution, probability calculation, impression management, and data preloading.

methods.name: runAlgorithm
methods.description: Executes the eCPM algorithm for each agency, updating priorities and eCPMs based on calculated probabilities.

methods.name: calculateDeliveryProbabilities
methods.description: Calculates probabilities for each ad/zone pair based on minimum impressions and available impressions.

methods.name: prepareCampaignsParameters
methods.description: Calculates minimum impressions per ad, scales impressions proportionally, and computes ECPM^ALPHA for campaigns and ads.

methods.name: getTodaysRemainingOperationIntervals
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining operation intervals till the end of today.

methods.name: getCampaignDeliveredImpressions
methods.description: Retrieves cached number of impressions delivered in a campaign today.

methods.name: setAdMinImpressions
methods.description: Calculates and sets minimum impressions for an ad based on weight and campaign requirements.

methods.name: setZonesEcpmPowAlphaSums
methods.description: Sums ecpm^ALPHA values across zones for an ad.

methods.name: calculateAdsZonesMinimumRequiredImpressions
methods.description: Calculates minimum required impressions for each ad-zone pair.

methods.name: calculateAdZoneMinImpr
methods.description: Calculates minimum impressions for an ad in each linked zone proportionally to zone contracts.

methods.name: addMinRequiredImprToZone
methods.description: Tracks total minimum impressions assigned to each zone.

methods.name: getAdZonesContractsSum
methods.description: Returns total available impressions across given zones.

methods.name: preloadCampaignsDeliveredImpressionsForAgency
methods.description: Preloads today's delivered impressions per campaign for an agency.

methods.name: preloadCampaignsDeliveriesForAgency
methods.description: Preloads total campaign deliveries (impressions, clicks, conversions) for an agency.

methods.name: getZonesAllocationByAgency
methods.description: Retrieves zone impression allocations for an agency.

methods.name: getBeginningOfToday
methods.description: Returns the start of today as a PEAR_Date object.

methods.name: getBeginningOfTomorrow
methods.description: Returns the start of tomorrow as a PEAR_Date object.

methods.name: resetHelperProperties
methods.description: Resets internal helper arrays for impressions and campaigns.
